description: ED Digital Twin is a database-driven discrete-event model published by Nirmani Amarasinghe, Laura Boyle and Adele H. Marshall at Queen's University Belfast. It fits arrival rates and length-of-stay distributions from historical emergency-department visits, then forecasts patient arrivals and discharges for twelve hours at ten-minute resolution. Zenodo preserves version 1.0.7 of the linked DataDriven_DigitalTwin repository as a ZIP archive under the MIT licence, free of charge. The model takes hospital-specific historical data; the landing page does not identify the hospital, training period or geographical validation range. The authors describe validation against observed patient flow, but no independent performance check was made during this metadata review. Potential uses include short-term bed-capacity scenarios and examination of uncertainty in patient flow. The archive has not been executed, and no related catalogue model is identified by the deposit.
